s1.syndrome_frame: Jaundice and upper abdominal pain with pancreatic involvement
key_facts: Normal serum IgG4 and amylase levels
Diffusely enlarged, sausage-shaped pancreas on CT
Delayed enhancement and capsule-like rim on CT
Slightly high T2 signal on MRI
High diffusion-weighted imaging signal on MRI
Diffuse uptake in the pancreas on FDG-PET
Multiple hypermetabolic lymph nodes on FDG-PET

raw.syndrome_frame: Jaundice and upper abdominal pain with pancreatic involvement
key_facts: Normal serum IgG4 and amylase levels
Diffusely enlarged, sausage-shaped pancreas on CT
Delayed enhancement and capsule-like rim on CT
Slightly high T2 signal on MRI
High diffusion-weighted imaging signal on MRI
Diffuse uptake in the pancreas on FDG-PET
Multiple hypermetabolic lymph nodes on FDG-PET

shortlist.label: Pancreatic adenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated CA19-9 level, jaundice, and intrahepatic bile-duct dilation

shortlist.label: Autoimmune pancreatitis
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse pancreatic enlargement, capsule-like rim on CT, and elevated hepatobiliary enzymes

shortlist.label: Chronic pancreatitis
shortlist.why_kept: History of abdominal pain, elevated hepatobiliary enzymes, and pancreatic duct narrowing

shortlist.label: Intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm
shortlist.why_kept: Pancreatic enlargement, delayed enhancement on CT, and elevated carcinoembryonic antigen level

shortlist.label: Lymphoplasmacytic sclerosing pancreatitis
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse pancreatic enlargement, low T1 signal on MRI, and slightly high T2 signal on MRI

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with jaundice, upper abdominal pain, and significant weight loss, along with elevated tumor markers (CA19-9 level of 76.6 U/mL) and imaging findings of a diffusely enlarged pancreas with delayed enhancement and a capsule-like rim, are highly suggestive of pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

rejected.label: Autoimmune pancreatitis
rejected.why: Normal serum IgG4 levels do not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Chronic pancreatitis
rejected.why: Imaging findings and tumor markers are more consistent with a malignant process

rejected.label: Intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm
rejected.why: The diffuse nature of the pancreatic enlargement and the presence of lymph node involvement are not typical for this condition

rejected.label: Lymphoplasmacytic sclerosing pancreatitis
rejected.why: This condition is a form of autoimmune pancreatitis, which is not supported by the normal IgG4 levels
